summary: Shows loading extra vars from a JSON or YAML file by prefixing the filename with @.
questions: How do I pass extra vars from a file?

answer_card.title: Extra vars from a file
answer_card.answer_md:
```text
ansible-playbook release.yml --extra-vars "@some_file.json"
ansible-playbook release.yml --extra-vars "@some_file.yaml"
```

Useful when values contain lots of special characters.
